brief: Podcast business stack — recording, editing, hosting, transcription, distribution, sponsorship management.

slots.tagline: Record high-fidelity video and audio for every episode and guest interview remotely.
slots.f1Body: Send guests self-paced recording links that eliminate scheduling conflicts.
slots.f2Body: Capture studio-quality sound directly from the browser or desktop app.
slots.f3Body: Every take auto-saves to the cloud for immediate editing access.

slots.tagline: Design episode artwork, social clips, and branded show assets in one collaborative workspace.
slots.f1Body: Build reusable cover art templates that keep every episode on brand.
slots.f2Body: Review final artwork with guests and sponsors inside shared Figma files.
slots.f3Body: Export PNG, SVG, and MP4 variants for every distribution channel instantly.

slots.tagline: Deploy the podcast website and RSS feed on edge infrastructure with zero latency.
slots.f1Body: Serve episodes globally in milliseconds from the nearest edge node.
slots.f2Body: Auto-deploy new episodes the moment content updates hit the repository.
slots.f3Body: Run dynamic RSS feeds and download tracking without managing servers.

slots.tagline: Turn raw recordings into accurate show transcripts and searchable text automatically.
slots.f1Body: Generate precise transcripts even with multiple speakers and niche terminology.
slots.f2Body: Auto-detect and label host and guest voices in transcript output.
slots.f3Body: Instantly summarize key takeaways into draft show notes and timestamps.

slots.tagline: Push new episodes to social platforms, email lists, and directories without manual work.
slots.f1Body: Auto-publish episode links to LinkedIn, Twitter, and newsletter platforms instantly.
slots.f2Body: Fire workflows the moment a new episode appears in the RSS feed.
slots.f3Body: Update Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and Google Podcasts listings in one flow.

slots.tagline: Invoice sponsors, collect ad revenue, and track campaign payments in one dashboard.
slots.f1Body: Send automated monthly sponsorship invoices with custom brand styling.
slots.f2Body: Generate secure checkout links for one-off ad slots or bundles.
slots.f3Body: Track monthly recurring sponsor revenue and spot payment trends instantly.

slots.ctaBody: Deploy this exact stack and ship professional episodes faster than ever.
